messages:
alex: Quick question — we're planning to change how model pinning works on /v1/generate. Instead of the `model` query param being the single source of truth, we want to introduce a `Model-Pin` request header and mark the old param deprecated. What are the compatibility risks?

maya: Reasonable. main concerns: SDKs, caching layers, and any customers parsing responses for a `model_used` field. Need clear fallback semantics. :eyes:

seb: From runtime POV we can support both for a transition period. Priority: determinism for cache keys. If header present -> use header. If not, fall back to param. We should avoid changing default behavior otherwise caching will split.

liz: Docs + SDKs: we'll need a deprecation note and migration guide. For JS/Python SDKs we can add header helper and keep param support for 90 days. I can draft PRs (SDK #3456, docs #789).

alex: That fallback ordering sounds good. Proposal: header overrides param -> param is fallback. Deprecation window 90 days after announcement, then a 30 day warning before removal. Thoughts?

jun: +1. Also recommend adding an opt-in header `X-Model-Pin-Strict: true` for customers who want hard failure if pin missing (useful for QA).

maya: Can we keep a `model_used` field in responses for transparency? Some customers rely on it for billing/metrics.

seb: We already include `model_name` in the response meta. We can add a stable `model_used` string field and guarantee it reflects the actual model variant used after routing/fallbacks. Backcompat: don't rename it.

alex: Example curl for SDK and support notes I want in the PRs:
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
     -H "Model-Pin: gptx-7b-v1" \
     -d '{"prompt":"hi"}' \
     https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```
If header omitted, legacy `?model=gptx-7b` still works during transition.

liz: I'll add a migration snippet showing both approaches plus the `X-Model-Pin-Strict`.

jun: Rollout plan suggestion: 1) Announce and enable both in runtime behind a flag (today) 2) Docs + SDK updates (1 week) 3) Monitor telemetry for two weeks (cache hit rates, unexpected model switches) 4) Post deprecation reminder at 60 days 5) Remove param at ~120 days if no major issues.

maya: Comms: send to #product and #customers with migration timeline and sample code. Customer success should get a pre-baked FAQ.

seb: Ops note: make sure rate limit keys and internal caches canonicalize using the resolution order: header -> param -> default model. We'll add a small migration test to ensure no cache fragmentation.

alex: Action items: liz to open docs + SDK PRs (links in thread), seb to add runtime flag + tests, jun to add `X-Model-Pin-Strict` support, maya to draft comms. I'll assemble a short deprecation email. Who wants to own the final announcement?

liz: I'll own the announcement once PRs are up.

deploy-bot: deploy queued: infra/feature/model-pin-flag to staging at 2026-03-17T14:30Z :rocket:

alex: Great — thanks everyone. I'll update this thread with PR links and timeline. :thumbsup:
